tree.heading: Federal Charter.—
tree.text: The corporation is a federally chartered corporation.

tree.heading: Perpetual Existence.—
tree.text: Except as otherwise provided, the corporation has perpetual existence.

tree.heading: References to United States Olympic Association and United States Olympic Committee.—
tree.text: Any reference to the United States Olympic Association or the United States Olympic Committee is deemed to refer to the United States Olympic and Paralympic Committee.
